about: Zocor 40 mg once daily and Cordarone X 200 are supplied together by brand only, so simvastatin exceeds the 20 mg daily cap.
Vytorin supplying 40 mg simvastatin daily and Cardizem are planted together in the middle of a 16-month history.
During the Isoptin course, Lipex 20 mg nightly replaces Zocor 20 mg nightly and the daily simvastatin dose stays at 20 mg.
